title: First and last latency sample per database
description: For each database_name return one first_duration_ms from the earliest sample and last_duration_ms from the latest sample by sampled_seq using FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE. Ties on sampled_seq are ordered by sample_id ASC. LAST_VALUE must see the entire partition, not only rows through the current row. Return exactly four columns: database_name, first_duration_ms, last_duration_ms, delta_ms = last_duration_ms - first_duration_ms. Sort by ABS(delta_ms) DESC, then database_name ASC.
hints: For LAST_VALUE use ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING.
After deriving identical window values per database, DISTINCT can keep one row.
solution_explanation: An explicit full frame avoids the common LAST_VALUE trap where the current row becomes the last value.
